text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh, Trainer-san.
Thank you for taking care of Tsuyoshi; I'm her mother.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text: Yes. Yes. I have been reading the materials you sent. Regarding the Satsuki Sho... Yes, my husband is also convinced.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Please continue to look after that child in the days to come.
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“......Huh?
Hello, Onee-chan? What is it~?”

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "Heheh~ Just wanted to hear my hard-working little sister's voice, you know? Ah, and also..."

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: "Tsu-chan's Trainer, how are you? Are you two getting along? Everything going okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
? Trainer?
Yeah. We get along super well, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
""......Oh, thank goodness~~~~!
You were arguing with your dad the other day, so—""

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Ah. Don't tell Tsuu-chan about that—!"

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
""Wait, what is it, Mom!?
I'm on the phone—""
(*Click*... *beep, beep, beep*)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Sis—!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
What is the meaning of this, Trainer-san?!
You had a dispute with my father?!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: Of course any parent would worry about their child's well-being~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
choice_data_list: Explaining things to your parents is part of a trainer's job too, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's family is also
well aware of her frail health.

Even so, respecting her desire to chase her dreams,
they sent her off to Tracen Academy.
I couldn't disregard such parental love.
choice_data_list: It's okay, we're staying in sync.

text_block_list.text: In her case especially, medical treatment is often required. There are many instances where parental consent is necessary as well.
choice_data_list: Your parents are rooting for you too, you know!
Your parents are rooting for you too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
B-But,
this is the first I've ever heard of that talk~~~!!
choice_data_list: This is something meant for guardians, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ugghhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Urrrgh! Fine, then!
Tsuyoshi's gonna turn it all around at the Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'll run with everything I've got and blow away all of everyone's worries and anxieties!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'll become an "unquestionably strong" Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho.
Her condition has picked up again recently, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! The time improved by 0.1 seconds too!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-san.
She flew off huffing and puffing with determination, didn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Well now! The Derby is right around the corner,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Yes. How were the results from the recent examination?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: First, regarding the ultrasound results for both legs, everything looks completely normal.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "However, we should be careful around your shoulders~. There was a point of concern in another examination."
choice_data_list: I see, then for our next training session—

text_block_list.text:
"I'll take weight training off tomorrow's menu
and consult the team doctor about an alternative routine."

—Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
will surely be able to run in the Derby.

“—I can become a truly strong Umamusume
who can defeat even my own generation.”
Do training. Get examined. Adjust the regimen based on the examination results.

Even if it's a tightrope walk on the edge, the three of us will cross it together.
Toward her glory that lies beyond—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ow... ow ow ow...
—... My stomach... uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Kh, Trainer-san!
Let her rest on the bench!
I'll go borrow a stretcher from the infirmary!!

I gently helped her to her feet as she crouched down, turning pale,
and had her rest on a nearby bench.

Stomach pain in an Umamusume can sometimes turn into a serious matter.
I just hope and pray she'll be all right...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Pulse and blood pressure are both stable.
Looks like the symptoms have settled down as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hai-ee~... ouch.
Sorry for causing you trouble~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: We're not done talking yet~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "...Let's have you examined at a larger hospital tomorrow for a second opinion."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Although the symptoms are mild...
this treatment will require complete fasting.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still, if I don't eat, all the muscle I worked so hard to build will...

...It's not just about muscle.
If there is a fasting period, the post-break meals
need to be easy on the stomach for a while.

If calorie intake drops,
the choices for training will become considerably limited.
The roadmap built for the Derby would go back to square one—

—No, that's not it.
Tensing up my face... I pretend to stay composed.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer...!
choice_data_list: Don't worry, we've got you covered!
Don't worry, we've got you covered!

text_block_list.text:
Back in the trainer's office,
I picked up my smartphone.
First, I need to contact her parents...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Please don't worry yourself too much over it.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Internal organ issues are a different story from muscles or bones.
Even if you take preventive measures, they can strike regardless.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"You'd think irregular situations like this
would never happen at a time like this...
but once you decide to run, they happen regardless."

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
In this case, we managed to catch it early.
It's on the better side of outcomes.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text: "Let's figure out how we should follow up on this going forward."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It's pitch black already...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —...But it's okay.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You said so too, Trainer!
It'll be okay! In that case, I'llâ

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: —...Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. H-Huh?
No way, why is this here—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Are you still chasing that dream, Tsuru-chan?
—The dream of becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
! Why, of course!!
Look forward to the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Was your school around here?
Why are you—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Hehehe~ I came to cheer on Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Derby, right?
So... I wanted to give you this.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: An origami crane...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
So that Tsuru-chan can run without getting hurt...
...An amulet!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Because things seemed tough during the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah... sorry! I made a total fool of myself!! Even after telling you to keep your hopes up...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Um, hey, guess what! Tsuru-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text: I-I know I'm in a completely different position from you right now, Tsuru-chan, but still!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Tsuru-chan is
my precious friend, and a friend I'm so proud of.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with a Big Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want anyone getting hurt.
I want to see you again... safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's okay.
I'm definitely going to be okay.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I must have that same "absolute"
that Symboli Rudolf has!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for the paper crane!
I'll use it as a lucky charm for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Just you wait and see what this future Derby Umamusume can do!"
The time leading up to the Derby slips by.

Once we decide on a path, there will be no turning back.
Even so—we must choose our destination.
